command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; date -Iseconds; echo '===SERVICE==='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service || true; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager || true; echo '===FILES==='; for f in buehne.html filmlook.js buehne_daemon.py; do [ -f "$f" ] && sha256sum "$f" && stat -c '%n %s %y' "$f"; done; echo '===RIG2==='; find rig2 -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,120p'; echo '===ANCHOR_TOOL_HEAD==='; [ -f rig2/messen_augenanker_exakt.py ] && sed -n '1,220p' rig2/messen_augenanker_exakt.py || true; echo '===ROLL_REFS==='; grep -nE 'kopfRollDatei|kopfRollAusgleichDeg|kopf-dreh|gesicht-rahmen|pupillen-glow|requestAnimationFrame|schleife\(' buehne.html | sed -n '1,220p' || true; echo '===PROCS==='; pgrep -af 'buehne_daemon|chromium|chrome' | sed -n '1,80p' || true
